assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All spatial layers, areas, ratios, figures and drawings must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.trigger: Organizer supplies rights-cleared official CAD/GIS/PDF with verifiable CRS.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, municipal, fire and heritage controls are absent.
assumptions.impact: The proposal keeps these values unknown and limits building/renewal content to method and prototype suggestions.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are schematic veranda-space prototypes rather than a current-building survey.
assumptions.impact: They cannot support demolition, ownership, total floor area or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: East-west links and the slow-mobility spine express desired connectivity, not approved engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: Transport, accessibility and utility professionals must verify every crossing and interface.

assumptions.statement: Shade, wind, heat and rain-garden performance have not been simulated with official microclimate and utility data.
assumptions.impact: The veranda kit remains a design direction pending seasonal measurement and professional modelling.

assumptions.statement: OSM features are used only to understand urban context and support legible diagrams.
assumptions.impact: Road, building, facility and heritage completeness cannot be assumed; no statutory or engineering conclusion is derived.
assumptions.trigger: Replace or reconcile with rights-cleared official survey, planning and facility data when supplied.

assumptions.statement: The three perspective images are AI-generated spatial narratives based on the v0.2 design language.
assumptions.impact: Materials, planting, users, buildings and spatial dimensions are illustrative and require professional site verification.
assumptions.trigger: Replace with survey-based professional visualization after the official base and design development are available.

assumptions.statement: The Veranda Receipt is a synthetic, offline tabletop and has not been authorized or run in public space.
assumptions.impact: Results show only decision-logic completeness; they do not establish safety, performance, acceptance or implementation feasibility.
assumptions.trigger: A real host, rights holder and professional team must complete G0-G6 before any physical or live-data trial.

assumptions.statement: Regional nodes are proposed evidence interfaces rather than confirmed institutional partnerships.
assumptions.impact: No named institution is represented as committed, participating or endorsing.
assumptions.trigger: Replace owner_type with a named, consenting interface only after written authorization.

assumptions.statement: Accountable roles are defined by function, while actual organizations and people remain unassigned.
assumptions.impact: No pilot or work package may open while sponsor, site steward and professional reviewers are unassigned.
assumptions.trigger: Record signed responsibility, service funding, insurance and exit acceptance before implementation.

assumptions.statement: The 2024 HD00-1601 and related street-block control-plan infographic is an official public-consultation draft, but no rights-cleared vector or final approved plan package is available in the submission source set.
assumptions.impact: Its spatial structure, facility counts and transport directions support alignment review only; they do not replace the provisional submission boundary, key areas, geometry or metrics.
assumptions.trigger: Obtain the final approved plan text plus rights-cleared GIS/CAD from the competent authority, reconcile scope and identifiers, then regenerate all geometry, metrics and bilingual deliverables.

assumptions.statement: The 500–600 m lunch-walk target, narrow-sidewalk/high-planter diagnosis, nearby everyday-life routes and run/walk separation preference are contributor lived observations, not a pedestrian census, business-causality study or GIS-measured office-to-park average.
assumptions.impact: They justify a named east-west gate and park program, but cannot be written as surveyed distances, approved alignments or representative public opinion.
assumptions.trigger: Replace with a rights-cleared site walk, sidewalk audit and professional accessibility review before any construction claim.

assumptions.statement: One to two full basketball courts at wider civic openings, plus optional one more at Dazhongsi, with standing runoff and benches instead of a grandstand, remain a land-use concept pending official geometry and recreation-space confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Court count, exact location and spectator space cannot be treated as a sports-facility approval or a Chaoyang-Park-scale cluster.
assumptions.trigger: Confirm remaining width, rights, noise and night-use limits with the competent park and urban-renewal disciplines.
